_note: Search spaces fixed before any tuning (decision 95). Changes only with a recorded decision. log = sampled evenly on a log scale.

M2_ridge.edge_rule: best at largest: extend upward by 2 decades once; best at smallest: keep (effectively unpenalised)

M3_xgboost.calibration: all three options scored in every trial (decision 134); see calibration_step

M4_random_forest.calibration: all three options scored in every trial (decision 134); see calibration_step

alpha.scale: scikit-learn (L2 penalty divided by batch size)

fixed.early_stopping: own loop: log loss on the inner 25% after each epoch; refit for the best number of epochs

M5_mlp.calibration: all three options scored in every trial (decision 134); see calibration_step

fit_fallbacks.failure: an error, or a warning that the fit did not converge
fit_fallbacks.all_attempts_fail: imputer: fill with training median / most common value (decision 109 rule 8); model in an outer fold: failed for that stage (rule 5)
fit_fallbacks.tuning_trial_error: trial recorded as failed with its message; counts toward the trial budget; winner from completed trials; every trial failed -> model failed for that stage (rule 5)

calibration_step.scored: every trial: all three options on the inner-25% predictions, cross-fitted halves (decision 126)
calibration_step.tie: log losses equal when rounded to 3 decimal places count as tied; the simpler option wins (decision 109 rule 7)
